context.transcript:
Hi, Melissa. I just spoke with Alberto on the phone.
He doesn't feel well, so he won't be able to work the
Hassoun Motor Company event tonight. I need you to
cover for him.
Oh. But I've never photographed a corporate event.
I'm usually here in the studio for individual or family
portraits. It would be a new challenge for me, but I
could use the experience.
Well, you have a keen eye. I know you'll do great. The
event starts at seven in the banquet hall of the Norris
Hotel. Remember, there's a formal dress code. You
should probably wear a suit.
Of course. I'll go home to get ready now.
context.transcript_translation:
你好，梅利莎。我刚刚和阿尔贝托通过电话。他身体不舒服，所以今晚无法去负责哈桑汽车公司的活动。我需要你替他去。
啊？可是我从来没有拍摄过企业活动。我通常都在摄影棚里拍摄个人照或全家福。这对我来说会是一项新挑战，不过我也确实可以积累这方面的经验。
你的观察力很敏锐，我知道你会做得很棒。活动七点在诺里斯酒店宴会厅开始。记住，那里要求正式着装，你最好穿一套西装。
当然。我现在就回家准备。
